sections.label: Chassis and body floor
sections.evidence: Broad black courses span between the wheels at y=3. Red bricks build the central body above them, while dark gray bricks establish the rear cargo floor at z=15–23.

sections.label: Cargo bed
sections.evidence: Dark gray floor additions and narrow red walls at x=2 and x=11 surround z=15–23. Red crosspieces at z=22 form the tailgate.

sections.label: Hood and lower cab
sections.evidence: Black front underbody additions carry broad red courses across z=1–15. The raised red region at z=4–8 leads into the lower cab at z=8–15.

sections.label: Cab windows and roof
sections.evidence: Blue bricks occupy z=8–14 at y=8–9, framed by red corners and the rear cab wall. Red bricks at y=10 cap the cab, alongside remaining hood and body additions.

sections.label: Bumpers and headlights
sections.evidence: Light gray strips span x=2–12 at z=0 and z=23 on y=3–4. White bricks #128–129 sit above the front strip at its two ends.
